headline: Pre-open news priced by midday: Tilray nudged up the low end of its EBITDA range; the stock is +1.0%
reasoning: Source: Tilray's announcement (before the open), summarized by Benzinga at 10:17 ET: 'raised the lower end of its fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance and expects adjusted EBITDA of $70 million to $75 million'; Canadian restructuring targeting '$10 million in annualized cost savings by the end of fiscal 2028'.
Move from Friday's 2.525 close: 2.55, +0.99% on 99,203 IEX shares; it peaked at 2.65 (+5%) and faded. A raise to the low end of a range plus small savings, priced through the morning.
